question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India has the highest number of million cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pakistan has the highest number of million cities among India’s neighboring countries, with cities like Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, and others having populations exceeding one million.
 
• As per the latest data, Pakistan has over 10 cities with populations exceeding one million, making it the leader in this category among India's neighbors.
 
• Karachi, Pakistan's largest city, is not only the country's economic hub but also one of the most populous cities in the world.
 
• India's other neighboring countries, such as Nepal and Sri Lanka, have relatively smaller urban populations and fewer cities crossing the one million population mark.
 
• Bangladesh also has significant urban centers, like Dhaka and Chittagong, but fewer in number compared to Pakistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Million Cities:** These are urban centers with populations exceeding one million. They are usually characterized by high economic activity, better infrastructure, and dense populations.
 
• **Karachi:** The largest city in Pakistan, it is a major port and industrial hub, contributing significantly to the country's GDP.
 
• **Urbanization in South Asia:** Countries like India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh are experiencing rapid urbanization, driven by economic opportunities and population growth.
 
• **Population Density in Neighboring Countries:** Bangladesh, despite having fewer million cities than Pakistan, is one of the most densely populated countries in the world.
 
• **Urban Planning Challenges:** Rapid growth in million cities leads to challenges such as housing shortages, traffic congestion, pollution, and strain on public services.
